features.title: Guild Temple and Mithraeum of Fructosus

evidence.note: The guild temple dates to the reign of Alexander Severus (222 - 235 CE). Based on epigraphic evidence, this shrine may belong to the guild of the stuppatores. A mithraic shrine with a patron named Fructosus is to be found in the substructure of the podium. Representative point: longitude 12.287804, latitude 41.753187. The source dates the guild temple to the reign of Alexander Severus (222-235 CE), so the start is approximate; the mithraeum lies in the substructure of the podium. Several claims name the Decumanus Maximus as the main street running from Porta Romana to Porta Marina, passing between the theatre with its Quattro Tempietti and the Collegial Temple that stands 'between via degli Augustali and Decumano', so its line must run through this point. Rests on claim:pleiades-981681540:1, claim:osm-node-10873805528:1, claim:pleiades-1554484:1, claim:osm-node-663491063:1, claim:osm-node-7300715214:1 (drafted draft-1).

The Collegial Temple is described as lying between via degli Augustali and the Decumanus, and a domus is named as being on that street, so the street runs south from the Decumanus past these buildings and the Collegio degli Augustali. Rests on claim:osm-node-10873805528:1, claim:osm-node-10873805530:1, claim:osm-node-10873805543:1 (drafted draft-1).

The necropolis is said to lie on the south side of the Via Ostiensis outside Porta Romana, so the road leaves the gate eastward just north of the necropolis. Rests on claim:pleiades-617979990:1, claim:osm-node-1573904451:1, claim:osm-node-663491063:1 (drafted draft-1).
